title: Things
description: Things - the devices around you: doorbells, cameras, sensors, meters, switches and locks (X4 callsigns), what each one can do, and the ones you ask to be told about.
summary: A device with no radio of its own is spoken for by a controller that airs its readings under an X4 callsign. The format has no way for a device to say what it is, so Things works it out from what it says: the state it reports, the readings it sends, whether it offers a picture. A doorbell gets a doorbell's screen, a meter a meter's. Nothing is fetched from a thing until you connect to it on the local network, by hand; then it offers what that thing's kind can do, which for a doorbell camera is a picture, a live view and being told when somebody rings.
